mainEntity.name: Can a 15P Td5 engine replace a 10P in my Discovery 2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes, but not always directly. 10P and 15P engines differ in emissions equipment and engine management, so we check your engine number, VIN and ECU before recommending a compatible replacement.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 10P engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Td5 engine supply only for my mechanic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery 2 10P engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as injectors, a loom or an ECU match, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

mainEntity.name: Do replacement 10P engines come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Td5 engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 10P engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
